cnCode.description: Combined Nomenclature code of the imported good (6-10 digits; spaces/dots ignored).

originCountry.description: Country of origin as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

tonnes.description: Net mass of the imported good, in metric tonnes.

importYear.description: Year the goods are/were imported; selects the applicable dataset version window.

carbonPrice.description: Optional explicit EU ETS carbon price (EUR/tCO2e) for what-if pricing. When omitted, the cached published price is used.
